content: Yerɑ Sɑlomɔɔ u nɔɔɡiru suɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ bwisikɑ ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ ɡuru wii sinumɡiru sɔɔ.
Adɑmɑ nɛ, nɑ nun wɑ̃ɑ yee ɡeeru bɑniɑ
mi kɑɑ n wɑ̃ɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.

content: Gɑri yi Sɑlomɔɔ
u Isirelibɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ
Yerɑ sinɑ boko Sɑlomɔɔ u sĩirɑ Isirelibɑ kpuron mi ɡiɑ, mi bɑ yɔ̃. Mɑ u bu domɑru kuɑ.
U ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni siɑrɑ. Domi u win nɔɔ mwɛɛru yibiɑ te u Dɑfidi nɛn tundo kuɑ u nɛɛ,
sɑɑ mìn di u win tɔmbu Isirelibɑ yɑrɑmɑ Eɡibitin di, u ǹ wuu ɡɑɡu ɡɔsɑ ben wusu ɡɑsu sɔɔ bu kɑ diru bɑni mi bɑ koo nùn sɑ̃. U ǹ mɑɑ ɡoo ɡɔsɑ u n kɑ sɑ̃ɑ win tɔmbun kpɑro.
Adɑmɑ Yerusɑlɛmuwɑ u ɡɔsɑ bu kɑ nùn sɑ̃ɑ yeru bɑniɑ mi. Mɛyɑ u mɑɑ Dɑfidi ɡɔsɑ u n kɑ sɑ̃ɑ ben kpɑro.
Nɛn tundo Dɑfidi wi, u rɑɑ ɡɔ̃ru doke u Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni diru bɑniɑ.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, yɑ wɑ̃ ye u ɡɔ̃ru doke u kɑ nùn diru bɑniɑ.
Adɑmɑ n ǹ wi, u koo nùn tu bɑniɑ. Win bii wi u koo mɑ, wiyɑ u koo tu bɑni.

Tɛ̃, Yinni Gusunɔ u win nɔɔ mwɛɛ te yibiɑ. Wee nɛ, Sɑlomɔɔ, nɑ sinɑ bɛsɛ Isirelibɑn sinɑ ɡɔnɑ wɔllɔ nɑ kuɑ nɛn tundo Dɑfidin kɔsire. Yen biru, nɑ Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni dii te bɑniɑ mi bɑ ko n dɑ nùn sɑ̃.
Dii te sɔɔrɑ nɑ win woodɑn kpɑkororu wɑ̃ɑ yeru kuɑ. Kpee bɛsi yiruwɑ yi wɑ̃ɑ kpɑkoro te sɔɔ, yì sɔɔ bɑ win woodɑbɑ yoruɑ be u bɛsɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ wɛ̃.
Sɑlomɔɔn kɑnɑru
Yerɑ Sɑlomɔɔ u yɔ̃rɑ Yinni Gusunɔn yɑ̃ku yerun wuswɑɑɔ Isirelibɑn nɔni biru, mɑ u nɔmɑ yiiyɑ wɔllɔ u kɑnɑru kuɑ.

N deemɑ Sɑlomɔɔ u rɑɑ turɑru ɡɑru kuɑ kɑ sii ɡɑndu. Mɑ u tu doke sɑ̃ɑ yerun yɑɑrɑ yen suunu sɔɔ. Turɑ ten dɛ̃ɛbu bu sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɔm soonu nɔɔbu. Ten yɑsum mɑɑ ɡɔm soonu nɔɔbu. Mɑ ten ɡunum mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡɔm soonu itɑ. Miyɑ u yɔɔwɑ u yiirɑ Isirelibɑ kpuron wuswɑɑɔ. Mɑ u nɔmɑ yiiyɑ wɔllɔ u nɛɛ,
Gusunɔ, bɛsɛ Isirelibɑn Yinni, ɡoo mɑɑ sɑri nɡe wunɛ wɔllɔ kɑ temɔ. Wunɛn bwɑ̃ɑ be bɑ nun mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ kɑ ɡɔ̃ru tiɑ, ɑ rɑ ɑrukɑwɑni ye ɑ kɑ bu bɔkuɑ yibie, kpɑ ɑ bu wunɛn wɔnwɔndu sɔ̃ɔsi.
Wee ɑ wunɛn nɔɔ mwɛɛru yibiɑ te ɑ wunɛn bɔ̃ɔ Dɑfidi nɛn tundo kuɑ. Ye ɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ kpuro, ɑ ye kuɑ ɡisɔ kɑ wunɛn dɑm.

Yen sɔ̃, Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni, ɑ nɔɔ mwɛɛ te yibio te ɑ nùn kuɑ mi. A nɛɛ, u ǹ kɔsire biɑmɔ win bibun bweseru sɔɔ wi u koo win bɑndu di, bii be, bɑ̀ n tii nɛni dee dee ben wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ, mɑ bɑ nun mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ nɡe mɛ wi, Dɑfidi u kuɑ.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni, ɑ de wunɛn ɡɑri yi ɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ mi kpuro yi koorɑ.
Adɑmɑ kɑɑ sere kpĩ ɑ sinɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ kɑ ɡem? Domi wɔllɑ kun nun turɑ. Kɑɑ sere ɡere dii te nɑ nun bɑniɑ mini?
Kɑ mɛ, Gusunɔ nɛn Yinni, ɑ nɛn ɡere swɑɑ dɑkio, kpɑ ɑ nɛn kɑnɑru nɔ te nɑ mɔ̀ ɡisɔ.
A de wunɛn nɔni yi n wɑ̃ɑ dii te sɔɔ wɔ̃kuru kɑ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ. A nɛn kɑnɑru swɑɑ dɑkio te nɑ mɔ̀ yɑm mini. Domi miyɑ ɑ nɛɛ, kɑɑ tii sɔ̃ɔsi.
Nɛ kɑ wunɛn tɔmbu, sɑ̀ n mɛnnɑ yɑm mini, sɑ kɑnɑru mɔ̀, ɑ sun swɑɑ dɑkio sɑɑ wɔllun di mi ɑ wɑ̃ɑ kpɑ ɑ sun suuru kuɑ.
Goo ù n win winsim torɑri, mɑ bɑ yɛ̃ro tilɑsi kuɑ u kɑ nɑ mini u bɔ̃re yɑ̃ku yerɔ,
nɑ nun kɑnɑmɔ ɑ yɛ̃ro swɑɑ dɑkio wɔllun di kpɑ ɑ bu siriɑ. A tɔn kɔ̃so nùn win kɔ̃sɑ kɔsieyo, kpɑ ɑ mɑɑ ɡemɡii nùn win ɡem wɛ̃.
Yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ̀ n wunɛn tɔmbu Isirelibɑ kɑmiɑ yèn sɔ̃ bɑ nun torɑri, mɑ bɑ ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ bɑ nɑ bɑ nun suuru kɑnɑmɔ dii teni sɔɔ,
ɑ bu swɑɑ dɑkio sɑɑ wɔllun di, kpɑ ɑ bu ben durum suuru kuɑ. Kpɑ ɑ de be bɑ yoru mwɛɛrɑ bu wurɑmɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ mɛ ɑ rɑɑ ben bɑɑbɑbɑ wɛ̃.
À n derɑ ɡurɑ yɑ yɔ̃rɑ yèn sɔ̃ bɑ nun torɑri, mɑ bɑ ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ yèn sɔ̃ ɑ bu sekuru doke, mɑ bɑ mɛɛrimɑ yɑm mini bɑ nun sɑ̃ɑmɔ bɑ kɑnɑru mɔ̀,
ɑ bu swɑɑ dɑkio sɑɑ wɔllun di, kpɑ ɑ bu ben durum suuru kuɑ. A bu swɑɑ ɡeɑ sɔ̃ɔsio yè sɔɔ bɑ koo sĩ, kpɑ ɑ de ɡurɑ yu nɛ tem mɛ sɔɔ, mɛ bɛsɛ wunɛn tɔmbu sɑ tubi di mi.

Gɔ̃ɔru tɑ̀ n duɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ, ǹ kun mɛ kɛ̃si kɛ̃si bɑrɑru, ǹ kun mɛ dĩɑnun ɡɔɔ, ǹ kun mɛ twee, ǹ kun mɛ kɔkɔnu ɡɑnu ni nu rɑ dĩɑnu sɑnku, ǹ kun mɛ yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ̀ n tem mɛn wusu tɑrusi, ǹ kun mɛ bɑrɑ bwese bwesekɑ yɑ̀ n wunɛn tɔmbu deemɑ, ǹ kun mɛ wɑhɑlɑ ɡɑɑ,
bɑ̀ n seewɑ bɑ kɑnɑru mɔ̀ mɑ ben bɑɑwure u win torɑru wurɑ win ɡɔ̃ruɔ, mɑ u win nɔmɑ suemɑ dii tenin berɑ ɡiɑ,
ɑ bu swɑɑ dɑkio sɑɑ wɔllun di mi ɑ wɑ̃ɑ kpɑ ɑ bu suuru kuɑ ɑ bɑɑwure kuɑ nɡe mɛ u sɑ̃ɑ. Domi wunɛ turowɑ ɑ tɔnun ɡɔ̃ru yɛ̃.
Kpɑ bu nun nɑsiɑ bɑ n sĩimɔ wunɛn swɛɛ sɔɔ ben wɑ̃ɑru kpuro sɔɔ tem mɛ sɔɔ, mɛ ɑ ben bɑɑbɑbɑ wɛ̃.
Tɔn tuko ɡoo ù n nɑ u kɑ nun sɑ̃ yèn sɔ̃ u nuɑ wunɛn yĩsirɑ kpɑ̃, mɑ ɑ dɑm bɑkɑm mɔ, mɑ yɛ̃ro u kɑnɑru mɔ̀ dii te sɔɔ,

ɑ nùn swɑɑ dɑkio sɑɑ wɔllun di mi ɑ wɑ̃ɑ, kpɑ ɑ nùn kuɑ ye u nun bikiɑmɔ. Kpɑ hɑnduniɑn tɔmbu kpuro bu nun ɡiɑ, kpɑ bu nun nɑsiɑ nɡe mɛ wunɛn tɔmbu Isirelibɑ bɑ nun nɑsie, kpɑ bɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ wunɑ bɑ rɑ sɑ̃ dii te sɔɔ, te nɑ bɑnɑ mini.
À n wunɛn tɔmbu Isirelibɑ woodɑ wɛ̃ bu dɑ bu ben yibɛrɛbɑ tɑbu wɔri, mɑ bɑ kɑnɑru koosimɑ wunɛn mi, bɑ mɛɛrimɑ wunɛn ɡee ɑ ɡɔsɑ, kɑ dii te nɑ nun bɑniɑn berɑ ɡiɑ,
ɑ ben kɑnɑru swɑɑ dɑkio wɔllun di kpɑ ɑ bu kuɑ dee dee.
Bɑ̀ n dɑɑ mɑɑ nun torɑri domi ɡoo sɑri wi u ku rɑ tore, mɑ wunɛn mɔru yɑ seewɑ, ɑ bu yibɛrɛbɑ nɔmu sɔndiɑ, mɑ bɑ bu mwɛɛrɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ bɑ yoru dimɔ turukuɔ ǹ kun mɛ mi n tomɑ,

bɑ̀ n bwisikɑ tem mi bɑ yoru dimɔ mi mɑ bɑ ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ mɑm mɑm bɑ nun tii wɛ̃, mɑ bɑ tem mɛni mɛɛrimɑ mɛ ɑ ben bɑɑbɑ wɛ̃, kɑ wuu ɡeni ɡe ɑ ɡɔsɑ kɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee te nɑ nun bɑniɑ mini, bɑ̀ n kɑnɑru mɔ̀ bɑ mɔ̀, bɑ nun torɑri, bɑ durum kuɑ,
ɑ bu swɑɑ dɑkio sɑɑ wɔllun di mi ɑ wɑ̃ɑ kpɑ ɑ bu kuɑ dee dee, kpɑ ɑ bu ben torɑnu kpuron suuru kuɑ.
Tɛ̃, Gusunɔ nɛn Yinni, ɑ de ɑ nɔni wukiɑ kpɑ ɑ swɑɑ dɑki kɑnɑ te nɑ mɔ̀.

content.text: ɑ seewo ɑ nɑ mi ɑ rɑ wɛ̃re,
mi wunɛn dɑm mu rɑ sɔ̃ɔsire.
A de wunɛn yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑ n fɑɑbɑ mɔ.
Kpɑ be bɑ nun mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ
bɑ n nuku dobu mɔ̀ doo nɔɔru sɔ.
ɑ ku wi ɑ ɡɔsɑ biru kisi.
mɛ ɑ Dɑfidi wunɛn sɔm kowo kuɑ.
